text:
Rhea: Quick sync 60s on paid performance. Morning spike is killing pacing by noon. Thinking daypart caps + holdback group to validate creative rotation. Anyone available to stand this up today?

Leo: I can set daypart caps. proposal: reduce bids 20% during 9am-12pm PT, increase 10% 6-9pm PT. holdback = 15% traffic not exposed to new creative.

Sam: agree on holdback. need to confirm UTM and pixel tagging on new creatives before roll. last time we lost ~30% attributed leads due to missing gclid mapping.

AdOps Bot: hourly-performance.csv uploaded -> https://storage.redwood.com/ads/hourly/233045. CTR down 0.6% AM; CPC up 8%.

Priya: creative notes: rotating headlines + dynamic sitelinks. I'll push two headline sets: "Launch LLM features in days" + "Lower inference cost, keep quality". also a short hero and a variant with a customer stat.

Leo: adding negative broad match for "free" and "open source download". keywords limited to: `llm serving`, `inference platform`, `inference latency`.

Sam: tagging plan: utm_source=google, utm_medium=cpc, utm_campaign=q2_launch, utm_content=creatX. also ensure gclid forwarded to crm webhook. test curl below:
```
curl -X POST https://hooks.redwood.com/inbound -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"gclid":"test-gclid","utm_campaign":"q2_launch","creative":"headlineB"}'
```

Rhea: SLA for mapping: webhook must return 200 < 400ms or route to retry queue. Also set conversion lookback to 30d for this test.

Priya: assets uploaded: https://drive.redwood.com/marketing/q2_launch/daypart_tests (filenames: day_a_headline1.jpg, day_b_headline2.jpg, lp_stat.html).

Leo: I'll implement daypart caps + holdback in Ads Manager. canary: 12 hours, 20% of total spend. scaling rules: only scale if CTR up >= 5% and CPL down >=10%.

Sam: analytics will create cohorts: daypart_test_holdback, daypart_test_exposed. will compare lead-quality (SQL rate) and channel lift. set alert if CPL increase > 20% vs baseline for 2 windows.

Rhea: good. final checklist: 1) Leo deploy canary by 3pm PT 2) Priya confirm assets and utm naming 3) Sam validate pixel and dashboards. update here when live. :white_check_mark:

Leo: deploying canary now. ping when gclid test passes. :rocket:

Sam: ran the curl test, got 200. gclid hits showing up in test dashboard.

Priya: creatives live in account, sitelinks added.

AdOps Bot: canary-spend.log created -> https://storage.redwood.com/ads/canary/233045/log.txt

Rhea: monitoring first 3h, will post summary. keep messages short here. :eyes:
